notes.title: Announcing my new Puzzle Game : DESORDRE !
notes.content:
Hello,

I'm happy to announce my new puzzle game called : DESORDRE, DESORDRE is a solo first-person puzzle game inspired by the portal series but here each puzzle need to be solved by traveling through two timelines of the same room. You are helped by your portal gun and the possibility to slow down the time.

You can wishlist now : 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097490/DESORDRE__A_Puzzle_Game_Adventure/?curator_clanid=40535158

Gameplay

notes.title: PATCH 1.2
notes.content:
Collectibles :

Rework of the collectibles system from scratch.
Your old data will converted for the new system dont worry it's just technical but very more accurate.

The player can see now how many collectibles remain in the room on the pause menu.

Pause menu :

Echap can now close the pause menu.

Doors in general :

You can be killed by the doors if you get stuck between them.

Rebind/bind :

You can now invert the mouse y axis !
You can also rebind the key to open the document.

We're excited to announce that Time Breaker is a recipient of an Epic MegaGrant from Epic Games! This allows us to provide a better experience for Time Breaker.


WHAT IS AN EPIC MEGAGRANT?

Epic MegaGrants represents a $100 million commitment from Epic Games to support anyone around the globe doing outstanding work with Unreal Engine or enhancing open-source capabilities for the 3D graphics community, whether they're creating a game that will delight audiences, telling stories in a feature film, or helping to save lives with state-of-the-art medical training solutions.
